title: Enzymatic dissociation of neural tissue
abstract: Optimization of enzymatic dissociation for adult mouse cortex.

methods.name: methods
methods.text: Minced cortical tissue (1mm cubes) was incubated in a dissociation buffer containing 20 units/mL papain (Worthington), 1 mM L-cysteine, 0.5 mM EDTA, and 1 mM CaCl2 in HBSS at 37C for 30 minutes. The reaction was quenched by addition of an equal volume of ovomucoid inhibitor solution (0.7 mg/mL). The mixture was triturated 10 times with a fire-polished glass pipette, then layered onto a 4% BSA cushion and centrifuged at 200g for 6 minutes at room temperature. The cell pellet was resuspended in HBSS with 0.04% BSA and filtered through a 40-micron cell strainer.
